name: Senior Depth
desc: System design, production ownership, leadership signals, scaling — what separates 4-YOE candidates from 2-YOE in final rounds.
tip: Strongest answers show judgment: state a clear trade-off, pick a side, explain why, in under 2 minutes. Listing every option without committing reads as inexperience even when the knowledge is solid.

r: Can you structure an ambiguous problem and make trade-off decisions?
Do you own problems end-to-end or defer to others?
Do you add value beyond "does it compile"?
Do you understand when NOT to over-engineer?
Can you describe impact in concrete terms, not just activity?
